description: This file defines an abstract base class AbstractHonoClient used for implementing Hono API clients that interact over AMQP 1.0 protocol. It manages connections, messaging links, tracing, and capabilities, serving as a foundation for specific Hono client implementations.

classes.name: AbstractHonoClient
classes.description: An abstract class providing messaging and tracing functionalities for Hono API clients over AMQP 1.0.

methods.name: logError
methods.description: Marks an OpenTracing span as erroneous based on an exception, adding relevant tags if it's a ServiceInvocationException.

methods.name: newChildSpan
methods.description: Creates a new OpenTracing span with a child-of relationship for tracing a service invocation.

methods.name: newFollowingSpan
methods.description: Creates a new OpenTracing span with a follows-from relationship for tracing a service invocation.

methods.name: closeLinks
methods.description: Closes the messaging links (sender and receiver) and frees resources.

methods.name: setApplicationProperties
methods.description: Sets application properties on an AMQP message after validating value types.
